::: {.why-card}
### Robert Chatley
_Imperial College London_

Professor of Teaching in Software Engineering and Director of Software Engineering Practice at
Imperial's Department of Computing, where he leads the [Computing EdTech Lab]{.highlight}, which builds
open-source tools for hands-on learning. Before returning to academia he spent many years in industry as
an engineer, engineering manager, consultant and trainer. His work covers software engineering education,
agile development, continuous delivery and cloud-native architecture.

**Keynote (Day 1, 13:30):** Teaching technologies

[doc.ic.ac.uk/~rbc](https://www.doc.ic.ac.uk/~rbc/){target="_blank"}
:::

::: {.why-card}
### Nicholas Del Grosso
_University of Bonn_

Leads the [iBOTS platform]{.highlight} (iBehave Open Technology Support) at the University of Bonn,
providing programming support, training and consulting to more than 40 neuroscience labs across Bonn,
Cologne, Aachen and Jülich. He holds a PhD in neuroscience from LMU Munich and teaches scientific software
development, collaborative development practice and reproducible workflows in Python.

**Keynote (Day 1, 09:40):** RSE teaching structures

[nickdelgrosso.github.io](https://nickdelgrosso.github.io/HelmholtzAI-TrainingSeries2025/about){target="_blank"}
:::
